# Chapter 2

A long chapter, to run over more than one page.

**1.** The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, and then considers at some length whether the exercise was worth the trouble, given that the dog showed no sign of having noticed. It resolves to try a different dog next time, one with a livelier sense of occasion, and trots off to look for it among the hedgerows.
